# Synthetic neighborhood HTML

Small hand-written fixtures model the public Visit South Walton neighborhood directory (`var locations = [...]` embedded in a script) and the neighborhood page hero (`section#neighborhood-hero`, `.hero-title h1 > span`, `.hero-copy .copious`) inspected on 2026-10-07. Records, coordinates, tags and texts are generated by test code and invented; no live page, map key or source text is copied. Tests use MockTransport only; the suite-wide no_real_http guard remains enabled.
